component.name: Ward
component.summary: Offline work-credential vault that lets AI agents use secrets unseen

description.p: Ward keeps work credentials (databases, SSH servers, web logins, API tokens, AWS) in an encrypted offline vault and hands them to Claude Code and other agents without ever showing the secret. The wardd daemon runs the command with the credential in the child's environment and masks it in the output.

Each entry can be blocked, free, or require approval: the approval window shows the exact command and who asked, and only a PIN allows it. The Chrome extension fills logins only on the matching domain.
